name: bmfoldpoc
description: Proof-of-concept: can one /config row fold a plugin's other rows away (a config.describe hook answering isHidden, with $.ui.invalidate on change)? Throwaway; see README.md beside this folder.

foldNoInvalidate.description: hidden: the same hiding, but WITHOUT the invalidate call -- the describe answers stay cached, so the rows are predicted to remain until the plugins reload
